verified_facts.section: L3 Network Overview - Equities/Options, Figure 1 and layer subsections
verified_facts.supports: Customer Access, Data Center Core, Environment Core, and ToR are the four layers; this is Cboe exchange-side infrastructure.
verified_facts.boundary: Not a complete physical deployment for a named Lime customer; do not insert Lime into the original exchange drawing.

verified_facts.section: L3 Data Center Core Layer, table and footnote
verified_facts.supports: NY5 data center core uplinks to environment cores are listed as 4x100G Port-Channel. BZX Equities belongs to Data Center Core 3 and 4.
verified_facts.boundary: Core 3/4 are data center core switches, not environment core switches. The inspected manual does not disclose LACP use or a per-port connection matrix.

verified_facts.section: L3 Top of Rack (ToR) Layer, opening paragraph
verified_facts.supports: Each server NIC connects to two ToR switches in an active/passive redundancy model.
verified_facts.boundary: Do not infer two NIC cards, bond mode, LACP, or a specific host wiring implementation. Prefer server-to-ToR active/passive connection wording.

verified_facts.section: L3 Customer Access Layer, Switching Mode column and footnote
verified_facts.supports: 1G customer access entries are Store-and-Forward. 10G entries are Cut-Through with a footnote that the 10G-to-100G direction effectively operates as Store-and-Forward.
verified_facts.boundary: Cannot apply cut-through latency to every direction or every hop.

verified_facts.supports: Carriers connect customer data centers to Cboe demarcation points; Cboe recommends redundant connectivity using multiple telecommunications providers to each data center.
verified_facts.boundary: This is guidance for the market connectivity applicant, not evidence that each Lime end customer independently buys these circuits.

verified_facts.section: Ordering a Cross Connect to Cboe -> Required Information
verified_facts.supports: Application fields include registered BGP ASN, networks advertised to Cboe, and transit IP address; private ASN/address options are described.
verified_facts.boundary: Do not assign the BGP neighbor to every Lime customer; service ownership determines who provides this market-facing connectivity.

verified_facts.section: Multicast Configuration -> US Equities Production Environment Configuration -> Limitations/Configurations - Production
verified_facts.supports: The MTU row is 1500; members should configure their infrastructure accordingly.
verified_facts.boundary: Do not present 1500 as UDP payload capacity or infer an extra allowance for tunnels; no universal tagged-VLAN rule was found in the checked US documents.

verified_facts.section: US Equities Production Environment Configuration -> BZX routing parameters and address/unit distribution tables
verified_facts.supports: Production tables publish source prefixes, RP addresses, real-time and gap-response multicast groups, and UDP ports.
verified_facts.boundary: Do not substitute certification or European connectivity tables. These parameters do not disclose complete customer-edge IGMP/PIM configuration.

verified_facts.section: US Equities Production Environment Configuration -> Limitations/Configurations - Production
verified_facts.supports: Gig-Shaped is 1 Gb/s; WAN-Shaped is 100 Mb/s. Real-time and gap multicast head ends shape their output to reduce packet loss.
verified_facts.boundary: These are the named shaped feed products, not a statement about all feeds, every physical port, or Cboe DSCP/priority-queue policy.

verified_facts.supports: Routers can filter by source/destination prefixes and protocol/port attributes; boundary restrictions are discussed. Applying provided market service parameters to an institutional boundary ACL is a documented general design check.
verified_facts.boundary: This is not a Cboe ACL template, mandated rule set, or claim about unobserved deployed filters.

verified_facts.supports: Forwarding rules evaluate incoming interfaces against RPF interfaces towards the source or RP and multicast forwarding state.
verified_facts.boundary: Source RPF is not restricted to RP-based services. Prior course diagrams and this standard use RPF; no IPF term was identified for this scenario.

verified_facts.supports: Excess traffic at an egress is queued or dropped; schedulers select departures from inputs according to configured disciplines.
verified_facts.boundary: This generic model does not establish any Cboe DSCP, queue number, strict-priority policy, or interface threshold. Current student text uses the directly documented PITCH shaping case instead.
